description:
Morning Music | Veena Instrumental for a Gentle Start | 1.5 Hours

For mornings when you want to wake up without rushing — this is your soundtrack.

90 minutes of slow, meditative Veena (the ancient long-necked lute of South India, deep and resonant) designed to ease you into the day without jolt.

What you'll hear:
• Slow Hindustani/Carnatic Veena — sweet resonant plucked-string phrasing
• Soft tanpura drone underneath
• Recorded warm and acoustic, no electronic processing
• Sustained melodic lines with breath between phrases

Best for:
• Morning meditation and mindful wake-up
• Slow coffee, journaling, yoga
• Focused morning work sessions
• Gentle Sunday morning atmosphere
• Anyone tired of energetic morning playlists

Brew coffee. Press play. Begin softly.
